images.title: A cuboid on the isometric grid
images.purpose: Show a 1 by 2 by 3 cuboid on an isometric grid with each family of parallel edges in its own colour.
images.composition: One cuboid centred on a faint isometric dot grid, edges coloured by direction, with short labels.
images.exact_structure: Background: a faint isometric dot grid, dots spaced one unit apart, in a pale tint of the outline colour #2B2B2B, extending 2 units beyond the cuboid on every side. One cuboid drawn on it with every corner on a dot: 1 unit along the length direction (slanting up to the right), 2 units along the depth direction (slanting up to the left) and 3 units tall. Exactly 9 visible edges, no hidden edges: the 3 length edges (1 unit each) in teal #0072B2, the 3 depth edges (2 units each) in amber #E69F00, the 3 vertical height edges (3 units each) in reddish purple #CC79A7. Faces white. Labels next to one edge of each colour: 'length 1', 'depth 2', 'height 3'. Under the cuboid, '18 units in all'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Parallel edges stay parallel and each unit is the same length, so you draw by counting units.
